svg.title: KawaGiif architecture — Rust backend and React frontend
svg.text: Rust owns state, windows and disk; React draws and asks. Every module, function, input and the relations between them. Generated from the source on 2026-10-01.
emit / emit_to: Rust event → React listener
[app, state, window] = argument injected by Tauri (AppHandle / State<T> / caller WebviewWindow), not sent by React. Junction dot = several wires share one bus lane.
outer column: internals that React never calls · inner column: modules exposing commands
inner column: everything that invokes or listens · outer column: entries, shared lib, hooks, presentational
